items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: Whenever I see Ed Palermo rehearsing at the union I’ll come in the door... So when Ed speaks to me, when he sees I’m there he speaks to me

ctx.x: They say, “Yeah well the black guys don’t use the same kind of tuning we do. Their precision is a little off you know, there. Can’t be trusted to carry the load properly.” And I actually try to work against that. What’s his name, Ed Palermo? Whenever I see Ed Palermo rehearsing at the union I’ll come in the door and I’ll act like I’m counting to see the ratio of white to black. There was never any blacks. So when Ed speaks to me, when he sees I’m there he speaks to me, all I say is, “Get some brothers in here man.”
Well I wish he’d pay attention. Well that’s a good way to end today.
